subject: Air freight quote to MIA
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the cheapest air freight option to MIA (Miami, US), including truck pickup from our site in 35622 (Giessen), Germany? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-25.

It’s 5 pieces of automotive sensors, 638 kg gross and 3.93 cbm. Please quote an all-in price in EUR and attach the offer as a PDF to your reply so our purchasing department can file it.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech
